title: SyncPlayers
description: A fun plugin to play with friends, which syncs the inventory, health, saturation, hotbar slot selected, to all the players who are linked using the command
body:
# SyncPlayers

**Paper 1.21.1 Plugin** - Link player states across your server!

## Description
SyncPlayers lets server admins link multiple players together using `/link <player1> <player2> ...`, instantly syncing their **inventory**, **health**, **food saturation**, and **hotbar slot** in real-time. Use `/resync` to refresh all links anytime. Perfect for playing with friends as a fun challenge.

## Features
- 🔗 Syncs inventory, health, saturation, and hotbar slot
- 👥 Supports 2+ players per link (unlimited)
- ⚡ `/resync` for instant updates for all according to the person who ran the command (just in case something goes wrong)
- 🏗️ Optimized for Paper 1.21.1 (Spigot compatible)
- 🎯 Lightweight - no performance impact

## Commands
- `/link <player1> <player2> ...` - Link players (syncplayers.link)
- `/resync` - Refresh all links (syncplayers.resync)

## Permissions
- `syncplayers.link` - Use /link command
- `syncplayers.resync` - Use /resync command
